label: Rav Mešaršia son of Qaqay incantation bowl
summary: Jewish Babylonian Aramaic bowl naming the Babylonian sage Rav Mešaršia son of Qaqay; the article also identifies his likely wife and mother.

source.title: An Incantation Bowl for Rav Mešaršia Son of Qaqay
source.citation: Ford, James Nathan, and Alon Ten-Ami. ‘An Incantation Bowl for Rav Mešaršia Son of Qaqay’ [Hebrew]. Tarbiz 80, no. 2 (2012): 219–230. JSTOR 23607828.
source.notes: JSTOR supplies stable bibliographic metadata and indexed snippets; the complete article is not openly downloadable in this campaign.

appearance.description: Edition of one incantation bowl; no collection number was exposed by accessible metadata.

claims.value_text: Unknown / not exposed in accessible bibliographic metadata
Rav Mešaršia son of Qaqay; probably Dudi daughter of Aḥata
Qaqay daughter of Marat is identified as Rav Mešaršia's mother

texts.content: The inscription names Rav Mešaršia son of Qaqay and appears also to concern Dudi daughter of Aḥata; the editors connect Qaqay daughter of Marat with his mother.
texts.editor: Discovery-campaign summary of indexed article metadata
